data.name: 36 hours before this week (read-only)
data.value: 本周开始前 36 小时（只读）

data.name: Drag to another engineer to swap the entire week, or click to select a target employee.
data.value: 拖动到另一位工程师上即可交换整周排班，或点击以选择目标员工。

data.name: Scroll horizontally to view the full schedule; hover, focus, or click a color block to view shift details. The red line indicates the current time when the page loaded. Vertical buttons on the right side of the employee column and at the far right of the timeline expand 36 hours before the start and after the end of the week (actual UTC duration, including DST changes), collapsed by default. Expanded areas use the same date headers, 6-hour increments, and grid as the current week. Gray shifts on both sides are view-only, non-editable, and excluded from weekly statistics; switch to the corresponding week to make adjustments. Shifts for the current team and other teams are displayed on the same row: admins can edit colored shifts for their own group, while gray shifts from other teams show team and time for reference only. Empty slots can be manually scheduled in 'Add Shift' mode.
data.value: 横向滚动以查看完整排班；将鼠标悬停在、聚焦于或点击彩色班次块，可查看班次详情。红线表示页面加载时的当前时间。员工列右侧和时间轴最右侧的垂直按钮可展开周开始前和结束后各 36 小时的时间范围（按实际 UTC 时长计算，包含夏令时变化），默认处于折叠状态。展开区域使用与当前周相同的日期标题、6 小时间隔和网格。两侧的灰色班次仅供查看，无法编辑，也不计入每周统计；如需调整，请切换到对应的周。当前团队和其他团队的班次会显示在同一行：管理员可以编辑所属团队的彩色班次，而其他团队的灰色班次仅显示团队和时间以供参考。在“添加班次”模式下，可以为未排班时段手动安排班次。

data.name: Select a shift to see its details. Scroll horizontally to see the full week.
data.value: 选择一个班次以查看其详细信息。水平滚动以查看整周安排。

data.name: The timeline is read-only. Edit shifts in the table. Warning markers include gaps, overlaps and team reminders; select a marker for details. Statistics count only time within this week and merge overlapping assignments for each person.
data.value: 甘特图仅供展示，请在表格中编辑班段。提醒标记包含空档、重叠及团队提醒，选择标记可查看详情。统计仅计入显示范围内的时长，并合并每人的重叠值班时间。

data.name: Drag a shift to move its person or time; drag its edges to resize. Changes remain drafts until saved.
data.value: 拖动班次可调整人员或时间，拖动边缘可调整起止时间。所有修改在保存前均为草稿。

data.name: Drag the body of a shift to change its time or person. Drag the left or right edge to adjust its start or end. Drag a handover to change both adjoining shifts.
data.value: 拖动班次主体可调整时间或人员；拖动左、右边缘可调整开始、结束时间；拖动交接点可同时调整相邻的两个班次。

data.name: Shifts for the same person or unassigned row cannot overlap. Dragging stops at neighboring shifts.
data.value: 同一人员或未分配行中的班次不能重叠。拖动会在相邻班次的边界处停止。

data.name: Drag across a blank member row to create a shift. Times snap to shift edges, template handovers, local midnight and now within 10 pixels; otherwise they snap to 30 minutes. Hold Alt for minute precision. On touch screens, hold before dragging; scroll horizontally using the time axis or chart background.
data.value: 在成员行的空白处拖动可创建班次。在 10 像素范围内，时间会吸附到班次边缘、模板交接点、当地午夜及当前时刻；否则按 30 分钟对齐。按住 Alt 可精确到分钟。触屏操作请先长按再拖动；可在时间轴或图表背景上横向滑动。

data.name: Focus a shift: Left/Right moves time, Up/Down changes person. Shift + Left/Right adjusts the end; Shift + Up/Down adjusts the start. Enter opens exact editing, Delete removes, and Escape cancels.
data.value: 聚焦班次后，左/右方向键调整时间，上/下方向键调整人员。Shift + 左/右调整结束时间，Shift + 上/下调整开始时间。Enter 打开精确编辑，Delete 删除，Escape 取消。

data.name: Use Precise editing / bulk operations for exact times, zero or multiple members, moving a selected shift, swapping members, or copying a range. Undo, redo and reset include copied drafts. Save publishes your changes.
data.value: 在“精确编辑 / 批量操作”中可输入精确时间、设置无人或多人班次、移动选中班次、交换成员或复制范围。撤销、重做和重置也包含复制的草稿；保存后才会发布更改。

data.name: Adjacent weeks and other teams are read-only. Warning markers include gaps, overlaps and team reminders; select a marker for details. Statistics count only time within the visible range and merge overlapping assignments for each person.
data.value: 相邻周及其他团队的班次为只读。提醒标记包括空档、重叠和团队提醒，选择标记可查看详情。统计仅计入显示范围内的时长，并合并每人的重叠值班时间。

data.name: Drop a shift onto another assigned shift to exchange their members.
data.value: 将班次拖到另一个已分配的班次上，可交换两者的值班成员。

data.name: Drag Swap full week to another member, or select the button then select the target member row, to exchange their schedules across the visible range.
data.value: 将“交换整周”按钮拖到另一名成员，或先选择该按钮再选择目标成员行，即可交换两人在当前显示范围内的排班。
